      • open

        EditorObject open(EditorAction action)
           throws CommandException
        Opens the editor. Be sure that the opened transaction is closed, since this allocates massive resources on the server side. Using try-with-resources is recommended:
         SomeObject obj = ...
 try (EditorObject editor = obj.createEditor().open(EditorAction.UPDATE)) {
   // do modifications
   editor.commit();
 } catch(RecordLockedException e) {
   // do handling
 } catch(CommandException e) {
   // do handling
 }
        Parameters:
        action - Action to perform on this Editor
        Returns:
        this, for method chaining
        Throws:
        CommandException - if the object is locked by another command or the command cannot be executed
        RecordLockedException - if the object is locked

      • objectId

        SelectableObject objectId()
        Returns an instance of the current or recent processed database object (is null during creation of an object). Use this method to obtain the persistent object instance of a newly created object after the commit.
        Returns:
        Object instance of the current or recent processed database object.
